title: 2027 BNY Analyst Program - Office of the COO (Dublin)
description: **Job Description** **2027 BNY Analyst Program – Office of the COO** The Chief Operating Office practice brings together professionals focused on operational excellence, business management, governance, execution discipline, and enterprise enablement. and deliverables across ongoing projects * Identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency * Assist with documentation of business procedures, workflows, and governance materials **Skills You Will Build** * Process improvement: understanding workflows and identifying opportunities to improve efficiency * Governance and controls awareness: learning how organizations manage oversight, accountability, and risk * Project and program coordination: tracking actions, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables * Reporting and metrics: helping compile dashboards, updates, and performance insights * Execution discipline: supporting the follow-through needed to move initiatives from planning to completion **Impact you will have at BNY** * Improving team It’s an opportunity to build broad business exposure, strengthen your professional skills, and contribute to work that helps teams execute more effectively across the organization. **Analyst Program** Our 24-month rotational Analyst Program is designed to set you up for success from day one. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide. Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary. **About The Team** At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at: BNY Newsroom & BNY LinkedIn **Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards** * America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025 * World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025 * “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025 **Our Benefits And Rewards** BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter. title: Building Surveyor
description: **About The Role** We are seeking a graduate or junior Building Surveyor to join our Dublin-based Building Consultancy team. The role combines technical surveying with regulatory experience/knowledge and client relationship management. Our work spans office refurbishments, mixed-use developments, commercial fit-outs, existing building assessments (TDD) for acquisitions and disposals. You will be required to work closely with senior surveyors, architects, engineers, project managers, and contractors. **Key Responsibilities** * Carry out building condition surveys, assist with dilapidations assessments and pre- and post-acquisition due diligence reports on commercial properties. * Prepare schedules of condition, specifications, and assist in the preparation of cost estimates for refurbishment and fit-out projects. * Review planning conditions and advise on how they affect design and construction programmes. * Assist in the preparation of site inspections and safety compliance under the Safety, Health and Welfare at Work (Construction) Regulations. * Assist in the preparation of clear, well-structured reports and presentations for clients, including non-technical summaries for boards and investment committees. * Maintain accurate project records and ensure all work meets internal quality management procedures. **Requirements** **Essential:** * A recognised degree in building surveying, construction management, or a closely related discipline. * Membership of Chartered Surveyors Ireland (MRICS/SCSI desirable) or be actively working toward it. * Understanding of the requirements and obligations around dilapidations and related landlord and tenant matters. * Proficiency with surveying and reporting software, and Microsoft Office. * Working knowledge of energy performance requirements, including Building Energy Rating (BER) assessments and nZEB standards. * Understanding of fire safety design, fire engineering coordination, or Fire Safety Certificate applications. * Working knowledge of Irish building regulations, planning legislation, and the Planning and Development Act 2000 (as amended). * Experience preparing technical reports. * Full driving licence and willingness to travel to project sites across Dublin and occasionally nationally. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to non-specialists.

title: Electrician
description: **Company Description** Solar Charge Ltd is a growing renewable energy company focused on providing efficient, reliable solar power solutions to residential, commercial, and industrial customers. Solar Charge Ltd values technical excellence, customer service, and continuous improvement across all projects. The company offers opportunities to work with modern technology and contribute to the transition toward cleaner energy in Kildare and surrounding areas. **Role Description** This is a full-time Electrician role based in Kildare with a hybrid work arrangement, allowing some tasks to be carried out from home when appropriate (such as documentation, planning, and remote support). The Electrician will collaborate with project managers and installation teams, communicate clearly with customers, and support continuous improvement of installation practices. **Qualifications** * Strong practical skills and knowledge in Electricity and Electrical Work, including safe installation, wiring, and connection of systems. * Experience with Maintenance & Repair of electrical installations, ensuring reliability and compliance with safety regulations. * Ability in Troubleshooting electrical faults, diagnosing issues, and implementing effective solutions in a timely manner. * Understanding of Electrical Engineering principles as they apply to solar and general electrical systems. * Relevant electrical trade qualification or apprenticeship completion; valid electrician certification or license as required in Ireland. * Knowledge of national electrical codes, safety regulations, and best practices for working with live systems and at heights. * Proficiency in using electrical testing equipment, tools, and related software for documentation and reporting. * Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to work independently and as part of a team in a hybrid environment. * Full driver’s license and willingness to travel to customer sites in Kildare and nearby areas. * Experience in solar PV installations or other renewable energy systems is an advantage.
